integrity: Analytic proof reconstructs global convergence from a strictly negative tangent quadratic form; exact symbolic matrix certificates and a standalone reproducibility script accompany the result. Numerical trajectories are supporting checks only.
scientific_limitations: Exact deterministic replicator for three published illustrative payoff matrices and their two specified linear interpolation paths; no stochastic dynamics, spatial process, clinical calibration, pH-to-parameter interpretation, or global claim for initial boundary supports.
title: Sharp phenotype-loss thresholds along two published tumor-game environment paths
